source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) public downloads

method.direction: Only records whose UCDP text explicitly attributes the attack to Israeli/IDF forces are retained.
method.target_exclusion: Records whose text clearly describes Israel as the target are rejected.
method.warning: UCDP has no universal event-level attacker field. Ambiguous events are deliberately omitted, so this is not a complete census of Israeli attacks.

events.location: Ceasefire line with Israel, in the southern Governorate of Quneitra
